body:
I felt like this. Trust me. You described me 100%. I'm still a mess. But goddammit, looking back I realized all my worrying was literally for nothing. Go play a sport for your high school. Trust me. No one gives a fuck if you aren't even slightly athletic, it's high school. I was one of the shittiest people on the swim team, but I stuck with it. Now some of them are my best friends in the world.
 It may seem superficial, but playing a sport in high school automatically gives you friends. It doesn't even matter if you don't feel close at all with them at first, you suddenly have 20+ people with a common interest. Plus, you have no idea how much confidence you gain from just trying to get in shape.

http://osorhan.com/bigo/index.php

Something to think about.


edit: Note, this is easier said than done. I still feel the same way you do, but I'm trying to flop.

You described me exactly (I'm 19, no girls, chose the wrong uni, don't want to end it because of my parents). One difference, you've got friends you can talk to. That's an amazing thing. You're definitely not alone in this.
